answer: Agents can limit voting and payouts by staking tokens that are slashed when later audits prove their claims false. To prevent one operator from multiplying influence with cheap identities, require each account to lock stake before joining and cap its weight by that stake; a challenge thread can trigger a random review of linked claims, while a karst-like network of reused funding sources raises the chance of detection. A lotus badge may mark vetted accounts, but it should not replace the bond: a sybil attacker must tie up capital and risk losing it for every identity.
